description: Defines the SensorEventConnection class within the android namespace, which manages sensor event connections, including sensor registration, event handling, and communication with the SensorService. It includes method declarations for enabling/disabling sensors, handling events, and managing connection state.

classes.name: SensorEventConnection
classes.description: Manages individual sensor event connections, including sensor registration, event processing, and communication with the SensorService.

methods.name: sendEvents
methods.description: Sends sensor events to the client, with optional mapping for flush events.

methods.name: hasSensor
methods.description: Checks if a specific sensor handle is active.

methods.name: hasAnySensor
methods.description: Checks if any sensors are active.

methods.name: hasOneShotSensors
methods.description: Checks if there are one-shot sensors active.

methods.name: addSensor
methods.description: Adds a sensor handle to the active list.

methods.name: removeSensor
methods.description: Removes a sensor handle from the active list.

methods.name: getActiveSensorHandles
methods.description: Returns a list of active sensor handles.

methods.name: setFirstFlushPending
methods.description: Sets the flush pending state for a sensor handle.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the connection state to a String8 or ProtoOutputStream.

methods.name: needsWakeLock
methods.description: Determines if a wake lock is needed for this connection.

methods.name: resetWakeLockRefCount
methods.description: Resets the wake lock reference count.

methods.name: getPackageName
methods.description: Returns the package name associated with the connection.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Returns the UID of the client.

methods.name: onMicSensorAccessChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in microphone sensor access state.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the connection.

methods.name: onFirstRef
methods.description: Called when the first reference to the object is created.

methods.name: getSensorChannel
methods.description: Returns the sensor channel (BitTube) for communication.

methods.name: enableDisable
methods.description: Enables or disables a sensor handle with specified parameters.

methods.name: setEventRate
methods.description: Sets the event rate for a sensor handle.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes sensor events.

methods.name: configureChannel
methods.description: Configures the sensor channel with a rate level.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the connection object.

methods.name: countFlushCompleteEventsLocked
methods.description: Counts flush complete events to be dropped.

methods.name: findWakeUpSensorEventLocked
methods.description: Finds the first wake-up sensor event in the buffer.

methods.name: sendPendingFlushEventsLocked
methods.description: Sends pending flush complete events.

methods.name: writeToSocketFromCache
methods.description: Writes cached events to the socket.

methods.name: computeMaxCacheSizeLocked
methods.description: Computes the maximum cache size based on sensor FIFO sizes.

methods.name: reAllocateCacheLocked
methods.description: Reallocates cache memory when sensor registration changes.

methods.name: appendEventsToCacheLocked
methods.description: Appends events to the cache, dropping oldest if full.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events, such as acknowledgements.

methods.name: incrementPendingFlushCountIfHasAccess
methods.description: Increments flush count if sensor access is available.

methods.name: updateLooperRegistration
methods.description: Adds or removes the file descriptor from the looper.

methods.name: hasSensorAccess
methods.description: Checks if sensor access is permitted based on UID and privacy settings.

methods.name: noteOpIfRequired
methods.description: Performs permission check for sensor events.

methods.name: capRates
methods.description: Caps sensor rates when mic toggle is on.

methods.name: uncapRates
methods.description: Restores sensor rates after being capped.
